posts.title: New Update: 11-3-2026
posts.description: This week on my website: EL AND MAX HIT THE ROAD reaches its penultimate chapter! The goal is within sight, but with just about everyone after them, can El and Max manage to escape and get young Matthew out of danger? Then, my much younger self takes you back in time with this authentic chronicle of recorded events of the early 1990s... MY DISNEY DIARY!
